governing_line: The inside of dying is partly knowable, partly reportable, partly inferable, and partly none of the archive’s business.
purpose: Map records concerned with what the dying person may experience, report, remember after recovery, or leave inaccessible.
principles: symptom experience is not body spectacle
survivor accounts are precious but non-universal
silence is an evidence state, not a blank to fill

clusters.name: Dreams, visions, symbolic language, and near-death awareness
Symptom experience: pain, breathlessness, delirium, restlessness, sedation
clusters.danger: false reassurance, panic, or treatment advice

clusters.name: Lucidity, dementia, and partial return
clusters.danger: treating clarity as recovery or proof of hidden access

clusters.name: Recovered-survivor and near-death reports
clusters.danger: spectacle, afterlife proof, and universal maps

clusters.name: Fear, comfort, existential and spiritual meaning
